newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra to reveal Telstra lead managers soon.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra to reveal Telstra lead managers soon.

text.p: Australian Communications Minister Richard Alston said on Wednesday he expected the lead managers for the float of government-owned telecommunications carrier Telstra Corp to be announced very soon.
"(Finance Minister) John Fahey will be making an announcement on that in due course, well in very due course perhaps," Alston told reporters.
"But I don't have a name off the top of my head."
A spokesman for Fahey was unavailable to comment on when the announcement was likely to be made.
The government plans to sell one-third of Telstra by the end of calendar 1997, raising more than A$8.0 billion.
